escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Asia this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Kolkata Underwater Metro कैसे बनी? असली Engineering, by resham info, with over 267 thousand likes.
In second place, How Maharashtra Brought a Dead River Back to Life!…, by Aman Sharma, with over 313 thousand likes.
And number one: MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY | GTA 6 GAMEPLAY, by Techno Gamerz, with over 1 million likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
